 Gujarat 2027 Holiday Calendar List | Public & Bank Holidays Announced
 Gujarat govt announces 2027 holidays: 18 public holidays from Makar Sankranti to Diwali; check state government and bank holiday lists
 Gandhinagar 15 hours ago 
 Copy link 
 The Gujarat Government's General Administration Department has issued a notification listing the public holidays to be observed in state government offices during 2027.
 According to the notification, a total of 18 public holidays have been declared for the year. In addition, a list of optional holidays for employees has also been issued.
 The notification issued by the General Administration Department includes holidays such as Makar Sankranti, Republic Day, Maha Shivratri, Ramzan Eid, Dhuleti, Good Friday, Cheti Chand, Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar Jayanti, Ram Navami, Mahavir Janma Kalyanak, Bakri Eid, Muharram, Raksha Bandhan, Janmashtami, Samvatsari, Gandhi Jayanti, Diwali and New Year.
 List of optional holidays also issued 
 In addition to the public holidays, the notification also contains a list of optional holidays for employees. These include festivals such as Lord Parshuram Jayanti, Independence Day, Parsi New Year, Eid-e-Milad, Dussehra and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary.
 Muslim festival holidays will be subject to moon sighting 
 According to the notification, no separate holiday will be granted on another day in lieu of public holidays falling on the second or fourth Saturday or Sunday.
 Muslim festival holidays will be subject to moon sighting. The notification has been issued by the General Administration Department of the Gujarat Government for state government offices.
